title: A contractible open four-manifold with a complete metric of uniformly positive scalar curvature
summary: We construct a smooth contractible open four-manifold that is not homeomorphic to $\R^4$ and admits a complete Riemannian metric with scalar curvature at least one. This gives a negative answer to a question raised by Chang--Weinberger--Yu and Chodosh--M\'aximo--Mukherjee.
